chapter: Childhood and family in New Orleans
title: Brother Sam's band and the Marrero bass players
summary: Morgan recalls his oldest brother Sam playing trumpet and his early love of bass, especially Simon Marrero. He and Allen discuss the Marrero brothers and their father Billy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
